summary.text: Charles Cunningham is a Republican state representative who has represented Texas House District 127 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a U.S. Army veteran and a former Humble Independent School District trustee who works as a distribution account consultant with CenterPoint Energy.

paragraphs.text: Charles Cunningham served in the U.S. Army and earned a bachelor's degree from Our Lady of the Lake University.
His career experience includes working as a distribution account consultant with CenterPoint Energy.
Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the Humble Independent School District board, Position 4, from 2007 to 2019.
Cunningham succeeded Dan Huberty in representing District 127 and assumed office on January 10, 2023.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Urban Affairs, Public Education and Redistricting committees.
He defeated John Lehr in the November 5, 2024 general election and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary.
Michelle Williams is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
